name: minigraf_ingest_git
description: Ingest code structure from git history into the bi-temporal graph. Starts a background task and returns immediately. Call minigraf_ingest_status to poll progress.

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the git repo root. Defaults to cwd.

branch.description: Branch or ref to walk. Defaults to MINIGRAF_GIT_BRANCH if set, otherwise auto-detects the repo's main/master branch, falling back to HEAD only if neither exists.
